reviews.text: The staff are always welcoming and friendly.

ZERO STARS
I normally wouldn't write such harsh reviews but this is my experience after 4 years with this practice. They display poor communication, poor /incomplete advice - and the vet that saw my cat (Amber) was astoundingly unhelpful. I would actively warn against this practice.

Case in point: As my cat turned 9, the vet recommended changing her food but didn't mention that it needed to be done slowly and over time. As a first time cat parent, I followed her advice but decided to be cautious and changed just the dry food - this triggered severe gastric issues. When I frantically consulted the practice to try and get a little more context and understand next steps, I was constantly told to just "bring her in". I was not averse to that, but have a cat with severe anxiety and who hates the vet - i wanted to understand what we were looking for and whether there were steps i could take before bringing her in (and likely triggering further stress). No information was forthcoming. Even after booking them, and paying for multiple tests, I was not notified on the results and next steps until I emailed and called to ask.

Four months on, as a result of this poor advice and incompetence, my cat is still vomiting and in pain.

In desperation, I moved to the Medivet Kensington practice and the difference is like night and day. The practice keeps me updated on the recommended tests, the vets call me up for a quick update on treatment plans and next steps (without charging me for every 5 min call) and overall, help me feel reassured as to my cats progress. Over the last 3 months, they've suggested small but meaningul steps - including ones ji could try at home, in order to minimize in person visits that stress the cat. She is a long way from recovery, but I feel more reassured.

The result of careless and incomplete advice and subsequent pior communications has been months of pain and stress.

This issue is one of several I've had over the years- when I've expressed my dissatisfaction about the poor communication, I'm told that I need to book a consultation and I'm being demanding!

I highly do not recommend this practice.
Thank you Medivet St John’s Wood. The perfect neighborhood vet for my best friend, Jacob.

We have visited Medivet St John’s Wood a number of times now for regular check-ups, vaccinations and for occasional stress issues for our cat. We signed up initially as it is very close to where we live. However, we stayed for 2 years plus now and not swapped to other clinics which popped up in the area for the following reasons: The healthcare plan includes worming and flea tablets, annual vaccinations and two checkups per year, as well as good discounts for various services and products. What has really impressed us recently is how promptly the team helped us get travel documentations sorted out for our cat as we needed to be abroad for a longer time and we had to travel with him. The front desk staff are always professional and helpful (thank you, Helena) and our vet always handles Lando in a way that keeps him calm during appointments (thank you, Amber). The occasional freebies (Medivet branded ball and treats at the end of appointments for Lando) are a nice plus. The only aspect which needs to be improved in my opinion is the electronic system which alerts us about missed appointments, as it sometimes sends automatic reminders even when we attended or when the appointment was cancelled (either by us or the clinic). All in all, we are very happy with the service and we appreciate the good work veterinary teams do to keep our pets healthy 😊

I wasn't planning on rating but I've received a few reminder emails to rate my last appointment, so here it goes. Bit of a weird experience, I was five minutes late for a check up, and I apologised immediately on arrival. I often wait 5-15 minutes to be seen at prior appointments. During the check up, I asked a question about my dog's ears & tummy which were promptly checked, but I was told that if I have any concerns I should not be five (5) minutes late to the checkup as we only have 15 minutes allotted. The practice was otherwise empty. It was strange considering I'm not habitually late, I had already apologised, and it felt awkward to be told off as an adult. I have professional client meetings for my job, and can't fathom pointing out to a client that they're five (5) minutes late and that it's an issue. I'd still give 4 stars as I was happy with the care my dog received.

Dr Amber and team are amazing! Our dog isn’t always the easiest patient, but they always make us feel welcomed and heard. Everyone on the team has provided amazing care for our elderly dog, given accurate diagnosis, kind care, and clear, reasonable guidance on next steps.  They’ve even sorted out issues with our insurance company on our behalf when the company was dragging their feet to respond.   Would strongly recommend.

The veterinarian who attended to my cat demonstrated a high level of expertise and dedicated ample time to thoroughly examine her, aiming to pinpoint the potential source of her allergy. Overall, my experience was extremely satisfactory.

I cannot thank Dr. Amber Rose enough for all she has done for me and my little cat, Wizz! My cat fell seriously ill, and thanks to her expertise, dedication, and compassion she was able to get a swift diagnosis and a plan for him right away. Dr. Rose not only gave me answers when no one else could, but also provided me with immense peace of mind during a stressful time. Her professionalism and genuine love for animals shine through in every interaction. I cannot thank her enough for her exceptional care and for going above and beyond. I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Amber Rose to anyone seeking top-notch veterinary care. She truly is amazing.
